releaseNotes: Platform release: the founder UX review lands. Contradictions render as labeled claim entries instead of a joined sentence (detectContradictions now emits entries[] alongside summary, with a domain test), the Launch page gains 'The launch engine at work' — a founder-vocabulary step procession over the execution routes with session state, imported verified-result totals, and an explainer flow — and the review's confirmed accessibility, responsive, copy, and design-system fixes ship across every page. The engine's own state, reducer, and catalog are untouched; this manifest advances only to keep root package parity.
Brand surface: platform/web gains an SVG favicon and an Open Graph card (first-party URLs registered in source-registry.yaml), wired into index.html social metadata.
